purpose: Harden the leak-free CV for judging learned candidates (SOT-3010 directions 1-2): the cv.py leak-free guarantee protects the scorer, not a learner — a learned candidate needs training-side holdout too.

known_leak_checklist.name: Frame/cell/track straddles the train↔score boundary
known_leak_checklist.external_source: official evaluate.py per-video scoring; whole-.geff units
known_leak_checklist.cure: Score whole embryo videos (cv.CV_HOLDOUT is a strict per-video partition); never split a cell/track/frame across a bucket.

known_leak_checklist.name: A future frame informs an earlier prediction
known_leak_checklist.cure: Detection is per-timepoint; linking is forward-only (t→t+1); no parameter is fit across time in the classical pipeline.

known_leak_checklist.name: Local scorer diverges from the organiser metric
known_leak_checklist.cure: SOT-2995 confirmed eval/official.py reproduces the genuine tracksdata scorer byte-exact (divergence 0 on 8 golden + 8 real).

known_leak_checklist.name: A learner is trained on the very video it is then scored on
known_leak_checklist.external_source: official split_0 weights: fit on train split, validate on held-out videos
known_leak_checklist.cure: Train each learned candidate on a fold that EXCLUDES the scored video (leave-one-out); the classical champion needs no fit, so cv.py did not have to enforce this — a learned candidate does.

known_leak_checklist.name: Learner trains on the same-embryo sibling of the scored video
known_leak_checklist.external_source: public EDA notebooks: same-embryo videos share appearance/illumination/lineage
known_leak_checklist.cure: Train leave-one-LINEAGE-out (hold out ALL 44b6 or ALL 6bba), not leave-one-video-out, so no video of the scored embryo lineage is in the training set. SOT-2993's per-video LOFO leaves the sibling in → soft leak.

known_leak_checklist.name: Released weights trained on unconfirmed data that may include our holdout
known_leak_checklist.cure: Treat released-weights CV as an OPTIMISTIC train-contaminated upper bound, never a leak-free estimate (SOT-3011 0.81 vs leak-free retrain SOT-2993 0.62). A promotable learned number needs leak-free retraining.

SOT-3011 released royerlab weights (ILP.rationale: External/released weights; training-data membership vs the holdout is not independently confirmable → treat CV as an optimistic upper bound.

SOT-2993 self-trained UNet, leave-one-VI.rationale: Leave-one-video-out: the same-embryo sibling stayed in training (soft same-lineage leak) → still an upper bound, weaker than leave-one-lineage.

hypothetical leave-one-LINEAGE-out retra.rationale: Leave-one-lineage-out: no video of the scored embryo lineage was in training → leak-free CV, promotable evidence under the two-signal gate.
